tasks.name: Prepare Ingredients
tasks.description: Gather and prep all ingredients for the Beef Wellington

tasks.name: Make Duxelles
tasks.description: Finely chop mushrooms and shallots, cook down to remove moisture

tasks.name: Sear Beef
tasks.description: Season and sear the beef tenderloin on all sides for a golden crust

tasks.name: Smear Dijon Mustard
tasks.description: Coat the seared beef evenly with Dijon mustard

tasks.name: Wrap with Prosciutto
tasks.description: Layer prosciutto slices over the beef to create a sealing layer

tasks.name: Roll Out Puff Pastry
tasks.description: Roll out the puff pastry dough to a flat sheet large enough to encase the beef

tasks.name: Make Crepes
tasks.description: Mix batter and cook thin crepes to act as a moisture barrier

tasks.name: Assemble Crepe Layers
tasks.description: Layer crepes around the beef for extra protection

tasks.name: Wrap with Crepes
tasks.description: Wrap the beef in crepe layers

tasks.name: Wrap in Puff Pastry
tasks.description: Encase the crepe-wrapped beef in puff pastry, seal edges

tasks.name: Glaze with Egg Wash
tasks.description: Brush the pastry with egg wash for a golden finish

tasks.name: Score Pastry
tasks.description: Cut decorative lines into the pastry before baking

tasks.name: Bake Wellington
tasks.description: Bake in a hot oven until pastry is golden and beef is cooked to desired temp

tasks.name: Rest Wellington
tasks.description: Let the baked Wellington rest before slicing

tasks.name: Slice Wellington
tasks.description: Cut into uniform slices to serve

tasks.name: Plate Wellington
tasks.description: Arrange slices on a platter with garnishes

tasks.name: Prepare Sides
tasks.description: Cook and season any side dishes to accompany the Wellington
